title: v1.0.35 is out: API manager and accurate API lights
body: Release link: https://github.com/tjshea90/novig/releases/tag/v1.0.35  What changed: (1) The reason some APIs looked failing while their keys tested green: the engine's check of ParlayAPI read all 10 keys once per key (100 reads) and timed out, so the card said no connection while the scans used ParlayAPI fine. Fixed, and each API light now weighs the engine's check, whether the scans are reading it, this phone's own test (pull to refresh runs it) and the usage figures. (2) A smart API manager on the engine: a failing API is restarted, an important one earns a fresh GitHub runner after its scan (up to 3 in a row), then it is switched off with a message to you; one failing together with every other API is treated as the runner's connection and no switch is touched. (3) The bid desk now puts up first the bids most likely to fill (near the start, close to Novig's offer): measured on 339,555 bids. More coming in this session: faster bid desk, profit/CLV analysis.
